title: Which browser still works best on Vista in 2020? (Internet Explorer, Chrome & Firefox)
description: As you know Windows Vista reached end of support in 2017 and not many people use it anymore, but I wanted to see what browser could still do the best now in 2020.   Using my single-core netbook and with the power of editing, I bring you the browser test between IE 9, Chrome & Firefox.   Internet Explorer 9: .03 Chrome: 5:04 Firefox: 10:56  Some of the sites I tested: Youtube, Facebook Marketplace, CNN, Apple, Microsoft, Google, Bing, MSN.   The clear winner of this test was Firefox, although it took a LONG time to load websites, it was best at still loading content.   Let me know what you think in the comments below!   Please like and subscribe for more content like this! :)  Feel free to follow me on Twitter @IansTechYT  #Vista #Firefox #Chrome #InternetExplorer
